disposition_records.T14-OVERLOAD-WITNESS-DIVERGENCE: 30 public concrete overloads, 18 of which differed in bits from the witness (dot1536 2 ulp, as seen in P01). Phase 2: the Euclidean/Dot witnesses were rerouted to EuclideanKernels/DotKernels for the optimized types and 24 overloads removed. Phase 3: the Cosine witness was rerouted to CosineKernels and 6 overloads removed. All 30 are gone (source-compatible; D02 symbol diffs recorded).
disposition_records.T14-SEARCH-ARITHMETIC-SPLIT: Dot512 Operations scores depended on k; Cosine512 search used 4 arithmetics. Now overload = witness = every search route on every probe row (below the GEMM gates, which P02 owns; VectorProtocol.cosineDistance(to:) is a disclosed follow-up). Dot changes up to 1.54% on cancellation-heavy rows, and one overflow class −∞→NaN, disclosed.
disposition_records.T14-COSINE-POSITION-DEPENDENCE: The BatchKernels pair loop (B) differed from its tail kernel (A), so a candidate's cosine bits depended on N parity, chunk size and k. All 8 cosine range helpers (fused and preNorm × 384-1536) now use the blocked form of A, bit-exact in both slots and at the tail; P01 tiled parity stays exact.
